title: SLIDERS: Evidence Synthesis with Autonomous Database Reconciliation for Systematic Reviews
abstract: arXiv:2604.22294v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Systematic reviews requires comprehensive evidence synthesis from large document corpora to answer targeted research questions and are foundational in finance, social sciences, and other technical fields. Manual construction of evidence tables is labor-intensive, and recent LLM-based assistants relying on embedding or keyword search often fail to meet the coverage standards of systematic reviews. We introduce SLIDERS, a novel LLM-based methodology for automatically assembling evidence tables tailored to research questions for systematic reviews. SLIDERS extracts full-text excerpts that serve as direct evidence or as provenance for structured data. Core to SLIDERS is an autonomous evidence reconciliation coding agent that iteratively writes SQL to analyze and reconcile extracted evidence, bringing together information fragmented across documents, resolving inconsistencies and removing duplicates across records. translated_title: SLIDERS：基于自主数据库调和的系统性综述证据综合方法
translated_abstract: 系统性综述需要从大规模文献语料库中进行全面的证据综合，以回答特定研究问题，是金融、社会科学及其他技术领域的重要基础工作。人工构建证据表非常耗费人力，而近期基于大语言模型（LLM）的辅助工具依赖嵌入或关键词搜索，往往无法满足系统性综述的覆盖标准。我们提出了SLIDERS，这是一种新颖的基于LLM的方法，能够自动组装针对系统性综述研究问题定制的证据表。SLIDERS提取全文片段，作为直接证据或结构化数据的来源依据。SLIDERS的核心是一个自主证据调和编码智能体，它迭代地编写SQL来分析和调和提取的证据，将分散在各文档中的信息汇聚起来，解决记录之间的不一致性并消除重复记录。我们对SLIDERS进行了评估（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: SLIDERS提出了一种基于LLM的系统性综述方法，其核心是自主编码智能体迭代编写SQL来分析和调和跨文档的碎片化证据，从而自动构建满足覆盖标准、消除不一致与重复的证据表。
